text:
Ellen (Sales): Aurelia Systems sent a completed SIG/CAIQ and said the POC must run in their lab with HSM-backed keys. They want our answers and a quick deployment plan by Tue. Who can own intake?

sigbot: New risk ticket RISK-4720 created and SIG attached -> https://redwood.internal/risk/RISK-4720 :white_check_mark:

Ravi (Security): I'll own. Quick clarifier: do they require a physical HSM in their rack or would BYOK with customer KMS suffice for the POC?

Ellen (Sales): Customer comment: "Prefer physical HSM, but will accept BYOK if we can prove key isolation and no key export." Also asking about prompt logging retention and whether we can disable telemetry.

Priya (Support): Support can provision a non-prod token and a small test dataset once Security confirms acceptable options and provides handling instructions. We'll need an IP allowlist and contact window.

Omar (Solutions): Two recommended approaches: (A) Private deployment in customer VPC with customer-managed KMS (fast), (B) On-prem package with HSM (longer, needs SOW). I'll prep rough timelines.

Ravi (Security): Action items: 1) draft SIG answers, 2) list which controls require Legal, 3) request network diagram and retention window from Aurelia. ETA initial draft = 36h.

legal (Legal): If they require contractual HSM guarantees or custom audit language, Legal will need to review SOW/contract; expect 3-5 business days. Flag early.

Ellen (Sales): I'll ask Aurelia for the network diagram and confirm whether BYOK is ok as fallback. I'll also push on timeline.

Ravi (Security): Draft posted to RISK-4720. Marked controls: Answered / Needs Legal / Needs Customer Input. Will update here after customer sends diagram.

Priya (Support): Standing by to schedule lab test window once Security signs off on the plan.

Ellen (Sales): Thanks all 49f3fb. Will update the ticket with customer diagram when I have it.
